cards.title: Core idea
cards.body: Control plane high availability means running multiple copies of each component, usually on three control-plane nodes, so the cluster can still accept changes and heal itself when one fails. Running Pods survive control-plane loss, but changes and self-healing stop.

cards.title: How it works
cards.body: API servers are stateless, so they run active-active behind a load balancer. etcd runs as a Raft cluster needing a majority quorum; three members survive one failure. The scheduler and controller manager use Lease-based leader election so only one is active and a standby takes over when the Lease expires.

questions.q: Does going from 3 to 4 etcd members improve availability?
questions.a: No. 4 members need a quorum of 3 and still tolerate only one failure, like 3 members.

questions.q: Why is the API server the easy part of HA?
questions.a: It is stateless, so replicas can serve requests at the same time without conflicting.
